ground_truth.difficulty_rationale: Theory before vs after test — must understand generation effect confound
ground_truth.original_snippet: Participants were asked to write their theory after the test phase was completed.
ground_truth.modified_snippet: Participants were asked to write their theory before the test phase was completed.
ground_truth.description: Changed theory-writing from after to before test — act of generating theory could inflate understanding scores in Theory condition (generation effect), confounding the understanding measure

matched_finding.subcategory: Theory written before test phase completed
matched_finding.description: Participants in the Configurations + Theory treatment were asked to write their theory 'before the test phase was completed.' This is ambiguous—it is unclear whether theories were written before or after the understanding test, or during it. If theories were written before the test, writing the theory may have influenced test performance. If written after, the test may have influenced theory content. This ordering is never clarified and could affect the interpretation of the relationship between theory content and understanding scores.
matched_finding.quote: Participants were asked to write their theory before the test phase was completed.

ground_truth.difficulty_rationale: Absolute estimation vs comparative judgment — must know these tap different constructs
ground_truth.original_snippet: Participants’ understanding was evaluated by presenting them with pairs of wheels that differed in their configurations, and asking them to predict which wheel would reach the bottom of the rails first.
ground_truth.modified_snippet: Participants’ understanding was evaluated by presenting them with pairs of wheels that differed in their configurations, and asking them to estimate how long each wheel would take to reach the bottom of the rails.
ground_truth.description: Changed from comparative judgment (which wheel first) to absolute estimation (how long) — measures different construct; absolute timing requires calibrated knowledge, not relative understanding

matched_finding.subcategory: Missing description of understanding score calculation
matched_finding.description: The understanding score is central to the paper's conclusions, yet the methods never explicitly describe how it is calculated from the 10 test pairs. It is unclear whether the score is simply the number of correct answers (0-10), whether 'No difference' responses are treated as incorrect or neutral, how the score is decomposed into inertia vs. centre-of-mass subscores, and what the expected score for random guessing is (the paper shows a horizontal line in figures but never states the value). The statement that chance performance is shown as a horizontal line implies a specific value that is never reported.
matched_finding.quote: Participants' understanding was evaluated by presenting them with pairs of wheels that differed in their configurations, and asking them to estimate how long each wheel would take to reach the bottom of the rails.

ground_truth.difficulty_rationale: All-previous vs last-two configurations — must understand information parity in transmission chain designs
ground_truth.original_snippet: Participants could consult their two last configurations between any trials.
ground_truth.modified_snippet: Participants could consult all of their previous configurations between any trials.
ground_truth.description: Changed from last-two to all-previous configurations — breaks information parity with between-generation transmission, confounding cumulative cultural learning with individual data accumulation

ground_truth.difficulty_rationale: 3 coders but kappa values may not match — requires checking inter-rater reliability math
ground_truth.original_snippet: 5 individuals blind to the research question were explained the dynamics of the wheel
ground_truth.modified_snippet: 3 individuals blind to the research question were explained the dynamics of the wheel
ground_truth.description: Changed blind coders from 5 to 3 — undermines reliability of theory coding; reported kappa values may not match 3-rater computation

ground_truth.difficulty_rationale: MCMC convergence issues and robustness checks absent — must know to expect these for Bayesian models
ground_truth.original_snippet: For this model, the chains were inefficient and the effective number of samples for one parameter was low (see Supplementary Table 3). The robustness of the model estimates was checked by running additional models (see below). Additional models with more efficient sampling confirmed the reported res...
ground_truth.description: Deleted MCMC convergence warning AND robustness checks — hides computational problems with primary model and the verification that alternative specifications confirmed results

matched_finding.subcategory: Missing details on Bayesian model priors and convergence diagnostics
matched_finding.description: The authors use Bayesian multilevel models fitted with map2stan but provide no information about prior distributions used, MCMC chain diagnostics (R-hat values, effective sample sizes, trace plots), or how convergence was assessed. This is particularly important given that the pre-registered model for Analysis 4 reportedly failed to converge. Without this information, readers cannot evaluate whether the reported models are well-specified or whether the posterior estimates are reliable.
matched_finding.quote: We ran a series of Bayesian multi-level models in R. Models were fitted using map2stan in the rethinking package and 95% credible intervals were used to make inferences.

ground_truth.difficulty_rationale: Creates internal contradiction detectable within the paper
ground_truth.original_snippet: These results are consistent with the view that individuals do not spontaneously create multidimensional representations of object motion 15.
ground_truth.modified_snippet: These results are consistent with the view that individuals do not spontaneously create multidimensional representations of object motion 15. These findings generalize beyond the single-sex chain compositions used here, suggesting cultural transmission operates similarly in mixed-gender collaborativ
ground_truth.description: Added mixed-gender generalizability claim when methods state chains were 'exclusively males or exclusively females' — visible contradiction with design

matched_finding.description: The discussion contains a claim that findings 'generalize beyond the single-sex chain compositions used here, suggesting cultural transmission operates similarly in mixed-gender collaborative settings.' This claim is entirely unsupported by any data presented in the manuscript. The study used sex-segregated chains (exclusively male or exclusively female), and no mixed-gender data were collected or analyzed. This statement appears to have been inserted without empirical basis and constitutes an overclaim that could mislead readers about the scope of the findings.
matched_finding.quote: These findings generalize beyond the single-sex chain compositions used here, suggesting cultural transmission operates similarly in mixed-gender collaborative settings.

ground_truth.difficulty_rationale: 'Well-understood' directly contradicts next sentence about 'absence of explicit understanding'
ground_truth.original_snippet: The cultural niche hypothesis suggests that complex technologies like bows result from the accumulation of many, mostly small, often poorly understood improvements made across generations linked by cultural transmission 1,9,14.
ground_truth.modified_snippet: The cultural niche hypothesis suggests that complex technologies like bows result from the accumulation of many, mostly small, well-understood improvements made across generations linked by cultural transmission 1,9,14.
ground_truth.description: Changed 'poorly understood' to 'well-understood' — fundamentally mischaracterizes the hypothesis; contradicts next sentence about 'absence of explicit understanding'

ground_truth.difficulty_rationale: Creates internal contradiction detectable within the paper

ground_truth.modified_snippet: We fitted a linear model with “Speed” as the outcome variable, “Trial”, “Generation” as predictor variables and “Player’s identity” and “Chain’s identity” as random effects (see Supplementary Table 1 for model output). The final model specification was selected after comparing several candidate mode
ground_truth.description: Added explicit model selection based on data fit, contradicting the pre-registration claim that 'analysis plan took place before any data were collected'

matched_finding.description: The authors state that 'The final model specification was selected after comparing several candidate models based on fit to the observed data' for Analysis 1. This indicates post-hoc model selection that was not pre-registered. While the authors acknowledge deviations from pre-registration for Analysis 4, no such acknowledgment is made for Analysis 1. This undisclosed model selection process introduces researcher degrees of freedom that could inflate false-positive rates and undermine the confirmatory nature of the pre-registered analyses.
matched_finding.quote: The final model specification was selected after comparing several candidate models based on fit to the observed data.

ground_truth.difficulty_rationale: Speed=0 for non-descending wheels absent — must independently ask how failures were handled
ground_truth.original_snippet: Wheels that did not go down were attributed a speed of 0.
ground_truth.description: Deleted specification that failed wheels got speed=0 — without this, reader can't evaluate if increasing speed reflects genuine optimization or just fewer failures

matched_finding.description: Figure 2A shows vertical bars indicating the number of wheels that did not descend at each trial, but the text never quantifies the overall failure rate, how it varied across treatments or generations, or how failures were handled in Analysis 1 (which restricted data to last two trials 'to limit the occurrence of wheels that did not descend'). Analysis 3 attributes speed 0 to failures, but Analysis 1's handling is unclear. The failure rate is potentially informative about exploration strategies and risk-taking.
matched_finding.quote: Vertical bars show the number of wheels that did not descend (i.e. failures) at each trial in each treatment... Data were restricted to participants' last two trials in order to limit the occurrence of wheels that did not descend in the dataset.
